summary: Ontario tower at Dewdney Lake on the Chiniguchi River, listed as still standing on an online list; 2014 forum posts disagree, and later posts in the same thread say it was gone.

facts.status_note: Listed as still standing on an online list; July 2014 forum posts disagree, later posts say it was gone or taken out by helicopter, and no official source confirms either.

evidence.supports: Official name McConnell Fire Tower in the provincial tower layer
Listed as McConnell Tower at Dewdney Lake, Chiniguchi River, in the Mid-Northern Ontario section
evidence.quote: 8- McConnell Tower- Dewdney Lake, Chiniguchi River, Ont.

evidence.supports: MNR decided as of 2013 to remove many of these still standing towers
evidence.quote: The Ontario MNR has decided, as of 2013, to remove many of these still standing towers.

evidence.supports: MNR no longer maintains the towers
evidence.quote: The MNR no longer maintains them so please refrain from climbing.

evidence.supports: Poster asked whether the tower is still standing after not seeing it from Dewdney Lake
evidence.quote: I could not see the tower from Dewdney Lake.

evidence.supports: Reply: still standing unless knocked down over winter or spring
evidence.quote: Unless it was knocked down over the winter or spring, it is still standing.

evidence.supports: Another poster believed it was no longer standing
evidence.quote: It is my belief that the tower is no longer standing.

evidence.supports: Most easily seen from the mid to southernish part of the lake
evidence.quote: the tower can be seen most easily from the mid to southernish part of the lake

evidence.supports: Seen only briefly while paddling north on Dewdney
evidence.quote: You can only see it for a short time as you paddle north on Dewdney.

evidence.supports: Later post: a poster who flew over the area on 22 July 2014 said it was gone
evidence.quote: Zed you're right, I flew over today and it's gone.

evidence.supports: Later post (9 August 2014): taken out by helicopter the previous autumn
evidence.quote: It was taken out by helicopter last fall.

sources.title: Land Information Ontario tower layer (fire towers), open data query result

notes_for_editor: Position and name come from the provincial tower layer, which has no date, height or status. The still-standing list gives a McConnell Tower at Dewdney Lake; the link to the provincial point at 46.893809, -80.647704 is by name and area only, not checked against a map. The list's date is not stated, though it refers to a 2013 MNR decision. The 2014 forum thread is informal: its early posts disagree, and its later posts say the tower was gone (a poster who flew over it, 22 July 2014) or taken out by helicopter the previous autumn (9 August 2014). The story reports these as informal accounts and does not settle the status. The list's still-standing label is undated and does not reflect these later posts. Keep separate from McConnell 2 (ca-on-mcconnell-2), which is a different provincial record. Worth a human check, for example a recent aerial image or Forest History Ontario, before publication.
